regeneration_reason: Regenerated before integrating PR #3 into the current codex/web-review line after PR #2 was merged. The map preserves the evidence/runtime flow and adds the first-use onboarding UI/API/auth/database/schema flow, including its tests.

nodes.label: Web Entry
nodes.role: Loads global styles, renders App, and mounts FirstUseGuideController beside it.

nodes.label: Web App Shell
nodes.role: Authentication and dashboard shell; exposes dashboard navigation detected by the first-use guide.

nodes.label: Project Workspace
nodes.role: Composes project tabs and RunWorkspace; exposes workspace navigation detected by the first-use guide.

nodes.label: First Use Guide
nodes.role: Shows the per-user spotlight guide after mandatory password change, branches admin-only steps, traps keyboard focus, and persists completion or explicit skip.
constraints: Do not show before mandatory password change is complete.
Only final completion or explicit skip persists completion.

nodes.label: Client API
nodes.role: Provides /api/auth/me and completeOnboarding client calls used by the guide.

nodes.label: Fastify API Core
nodes.role: Registers core auth/project routes and then registerFeatureRoutes.

nodes.label: Feature Route Registry
nodes.role: Registers onboarding plus existing cases, definitions, runs, evidence, export and operations routes.

nodes.label: Onboarding Completion Route
nodes.role: POST /api/auth/onboarding/complete. Requires the current user, idempotently sets users.onboarding_completed_at, reloads the user, and writes an audit event only on first transition.
constraints: Repeated completion stays successful without duplicate transition audit.

nodes.label: Authentication User Mapping
nodes.role: Loads onboarding_completed_at on username/id/session queries and exposes AuthUser.onboardingCompleted.

nodes.label: AuthUser Contract
nodes.role: Carries mustChangePassword and onboardingCompleted from server authentication to the client.

nodes.label: Onboarding Migration
nodes.role: Adds nullable DATETIME(6) users.onboarding_completed_at without modifying earlier migrations.

nodes.label: Schema Validation
nodes.role: Requires users.onboarding_completed_at to exist as nullable datetime(6) before readiness.

nodes.label: Users Persistence
nodes.role: Stores per-user onboarding completion timestamp together with authentication state.

nodes.label: Audit Logging
nodes.role: Records onboarding_completed only when the completion timestamp transitions from null.

nodes.label: OpenAPI Contract
nodes.role: Documents POST /api/auth/onboarding/complete and the existing Web API.

nodes.label: Playwright Login Helper
nodes.role: Completes onboarding for the shared E2E account after login so the guide does not obstruct unrelated browser tests.
tests: GitHub Actions Web CI / Chromium E2E

nodes.label: Run Workspace
nodes.role: Run execution and evidence UI. Evidence feedback severity is explicit state after the parallel fix merged in PR #2.

nodes.label: Evidence Follow-up Style
nodes.role: Removes evidence panel shadow and applies equal top spacing to direct success/error feedback.

nodes.label: Evidence Routes
nodes.role: Evidence CRUD and procedure routes; unchanged by onboarding integration.

nodes.label: Markdown Sanitizer
nodes.role: marked + sanitize-html 2.17.7 rendering with restricted allowlist.

nodes.label: Web Runtime and Dependencies
nodes.role: Node 22.12.0, sanitize-html 2.17.7, moderate audit gate, and OpenShift-compatible container checks.

flows.label: Per-user first-use onboarding
constraints: Completion is server-side per user and idempotent.
Skip persists the same completion state as final OK.

flows.label: Evidence upload and feedback
constraints: Outer evidence panel and cards have no shadow.
Success and error feedback use the same direct spacing.
Onboarding integration does not alter evidence API/storage semantics.
